The result is always 200 with one of `valid`, `invalid`, `cancelled`, `refunded` or `already_used`. `valid` means this request recorded the check-in: if two devices scan one ticket at once, exactly one gets `valid` and the other `already_used`. post.description: **DEMO: no real money moves.** `outcome` chooses what the simulated provider does. `succeed` confirms the order, issues the tickets and emails them. `fail` releases the tickets and emails a failure notice. Send a unique `Idempotency-Key` per attempt; repeating it returns the original result (200, `replayed: true`) instead of charging again. Reusing it for a different order is `409 idempotency_key_reused`.
